description: Pattern-based column renaming with several modes (first_row / add_prefix / add_suffix / replace / mapping / mapping_from_column). Drop-in for Alteryx Dynamic Rename.

outputs.description: Same data, renamed columns (and one fewer row in first_row mode)

upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame
upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key

mode.description: Renaming mode: first_row / add_prefix / add_suffix / replace / mapping / mapping_from_column
mode.label: Mode

columns.label: Columns
columns.description: Restrict renaming to these columns. None = all columns.

mapping_asset_key.description: For mode=mapping_from_column: secondary asset providing the rename pairs
mapping_asset_key.label: Mapping Asset Key

mapping_key_column.description: For mode=mapping_from_column: column in mapping_asset_key with the OLD names
mapping_key_column.label: Mapping Key Column

mapping_value_column.description: For mode=mapping_from_column: column in mapping_asset_key with the NEW names
mapping_value_column.label: Mapping Value Column
